page.overview:
Who is Fred King?

Fred King was a deputy for the Haddonfield Police Department. He responded to a 911 call that brought him to the home of his boss, Sheriff Lee Brackett.

King, as well as the other attending officers, were horrified to discover that Brackett's daughter, Annie, had been brutally murdered by Michael Myers.

When Brackett arrived at the house, Fred tried to keep him outside of the crime scene, hoping to spare him from seeing the grisliness of the murder. Fred was later part of a detachment unit that contained Myers inside a shack off Eagle Road.

Armed with a rifle, King was one of several men to bring Myers down in a hail of bullets. Category:Male characters Category:Law Enforcement Category:Halloween II (2009) characters Category:Minor characters
